## Purpose

A `Pr*`-family module speaks ONE provider's pull-request surface behind the `PrProvider` port (`pr_provider.rs`), so no consumer ever names a provider or its CLI/API directly. `pr_azure.rs` is the concrete Azure DevOps REST adapter; `pr_provider.rs` is the port itself plus the normalisation helpers (`short_ref`, `status_from_azure`, `status_from_github`) both adapters must funnel through; `branch_state.rs` defines the canonical `PrStatus`/`PrLookup` vocabulary both build on. An unimplemented provider operation answers the stable token `PR_UNSUPPORTED` — never a fabricated "absent".

## Convention

Folder: apps/rt/src/shared/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 3

Every provider-specific fact (host patterns, API version, CLI/binary name) is spelled in exactly ONE adapter file — `pr_azure.rs` is the only place `AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT`, `API_VERSION`, or an Azure host regex appears. State normalisation happens through free functions in `pr_provider.rs` (`status_from_azure`, `status_from_github`) rather than inline matches scattered per adapter, and every URL an adapter builds is DERIVED from the local `origin` remote — never trusted back out of a provider response.

## How to apply

Add a new provider by writing one `pr_<provider>.rs` under `shared/`, implementing the `PrProvider` trait from `pr_provider.rs`, deriving its remote-parsing logic the way `AzureRemote::parse` does (closed set of accepted remote spellings, `None` for anything unrecognised), and adding one `status_from_<provider>` mapping function beside the existing ones in `pr_provider.rs`. Never let `commands`-face code import the adapter directly — always through the port.

## Examples

Ref: apps/rt/src/shared/pr_provider.rs
Ref: apps/rt/src/shared/pr_azure.rs

```rust
/// Map Azure's `PullRequestStatus` word onto the canonical [`PrStatus`].
pub(crate) fn status_from_azure(status: &str) -> PrStatus {
    match status {
        "active" | "notSet" => PrStatus::Open,
        "completed" => PrStatus::Merged,
        "abandoned" => PrStatus::Closed,
        _ => PrStatus::Unknown(PR_UNREADABLE),
    }
}
```
